kicker: Guidance direction · 1,128 Q2 FY27 calls read
title: Lenders guide up. Chemicals and FMCG guide down.
dek: Across 1,128 calls, 44% of managements cut or guided lower and 34% raised or guided higher. The split runs by sector, not by market.

chart.title: Net guidance by sector
chart.sub: % of calls raising minus % cutting · sectors with 25+ calls

stats.label: Cut vs raised, all sectors
stats.note: 492 of 1,128 calls cut or guided lower; 387 raised or guided higher.

stats.label: Financial Services, net
stats.note: 64 of 144 lenders and financiers raised or guided up; 36 cut.

stats.label: Chemicals, net
stats.note: 46 of 73 chemical companies cut or guided lower; only 15 raised.

read: Guidance is splitting by sector: lenders and auto makers sound confident, while chemicals, FMCG and IT are lowering the bar for H2.
sources: Vantage analysis of 1,128 Q2 FY27 earnings calls (BSE filings), as of 18 Nov 2026
notes: How it is counted: a call counts as raising when management raised a number it had guided before, or gave guidance that reads as positive; it counts as cutting when it cut a guided number or gave guidance that reads as negative. A call can count on both sides. Net = % raising − % cutting, per sector, for sectors with at least 25 Q2 FY27 calls read. Open Sectors → Guidance leaders for the companies behind each bar.
